task_scope: W02 local implementation; actual migration/credential operations remain outside local authority.

customer_accounts.user_selection: Shared identities; tenant membership administration plus separate stamp-owner recovery
customer_accounts.contract: Keep shared human identities. Tenant administrators control only membership/authority in their own tenant. Global password reset and account deletion require separately authorized stamp-owner authority; do not infer it from tenant membership or a global JWT admin claim.

services.contract: Registered credential identity and current revocation/grants are enforced; issuance, replacement and revocation are explicit. Machines remain independent of human login sessions. Do not authorize actual legacy credential migration or live credential operations by this local design choice.

preserve: Existing W02.01–.07 protections, W01 strict customer boundary and original full W02 requirements.
not_authorized: actual credential rotation or customer-data migration
